سغب: سَغَبٌ an inf. n. of سَغِبَ [q. v.]. (S, &c.) === It also signifies Thirst: but is unused: (K:) [or] thirst is sometimes thus termed. (Msb.)
سغبة: سَغْبَةٌ Hunger: or hunger combined with fatigue. (TA.) [See also 1.]
سغبان: سَغْبَانُ ; and its fem., سَغْبَى: see the next paragraph, in three places.
سغته: سِغْتُهُ 1 , aor. أَسِيغُهُ, inf. n. سَيْغٌ: see 4, in art. سوغ.
